fit_reason: Whole SUV, a 2016 Ford Escape, listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: White paint looks clean overall, though gloss reads a bit flat in the evening light on the hood and doors
Black lower door cladding and rocker trim along both sides looks slightly gray and faded
Headlight lenses look clear in the front shots, with maybe faint haze on the driver side
No interior shots, so the cabin can't be judged from the photos
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Ford Escape and it looks well kept. The white paint could use a bit more pop, and the black lower trim along the doors is starting to look a little gray. We do pre-sale details that come to you, including wax and trim restoration. Would you like a quote?
